question: The pilot project for UPI was launched in which year?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2016**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** pilot project for Unified Payments Interface (UPI)** was launched on April 11, 2016 in Mumbai.
 
• The National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI) operated the pilot project. 
 
• UPI is a system that** allows users to make payments** using multiple bank accounts through a mobile app. 
 
• It **combines several banking feature**s, fund routing, and merchant payments into one platform. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• UPI is an** advanced version of the Immediate Payment Service **(IMPS). 
 
• UPI allows users to make peer-to-peer requests, which can be scheduled and paid as needed. 
 
• Banks began uploading their UPI-enabled apps to the Google Play store on August 25, 2016. 
 
• In March 2022, **the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) launched UPI123Pay**, a UPI payment facility for feature phones. 
 
• Participants in UPI
 
 
• Payer PSP (Payment service Provider)
 
• Payee PSP
 
• Remitter Bank
 
• Beneficiary Bank
 
• NPCI (National Payments Corporation of India)
 
• Bank Account holders
 
• Merchant
